set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM surface/atlas. P1. Follow-up to bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3 (starts after its reconciled commit lands; that ticket's candidate holds the surface/reference paths).

Problem
The reconciled fsLR candidate (fslr-reconcile-20261001, docs/verification/fslr-current-main-20261001.md) refuses the real MNI152NLin2009cAsym -> fsLR32k route with ReferenceError.PointwiseInverseUnavailable: the surface lookup needs 6Asym points carried to 2009c, the locked TemplateFlow composite (sha256 2e3869a0...) only pulls 2009c points to 6Asym, and pinned reframe4s 9a450835 exposes no exact pointwise inverse. The handoff states "a materialized lattice inverse is a different numerical route and requires its own declaration and qualification". This ticket is that declaration and qualification.

Existing capability to reuse (no new solver, no upstream work required)
- main already has MniTemplateBridge.withNumericalInverse (modules/atlas/shared/.../TemplateFlowBridge.scala, landed 419fccf8 under bd-01M37FQFRRF1TW2REJPWS8BRM8): materializes the composite on the 2009c res-01 lattice, then reframe4s invertNumerically on the 6Asym res-01 lattice under InversionPolicy gates fixed before evaluation (coverage >= 0.99, round-trip max <= 0.5 mm, p99 <= 0.05 mm, one-voxel interior margin). Recorded: coverage 1.0, forward residual 1e-8 mm, reverse max 0.139 mm; vs ITK fixed-point inverse max 1.04e-2 mm. reverseStep already carries it as Confidence.Approximate.
- Independent oracles already exist from the 09-23 route work (integration/main-catchup-20260923 / PR8 206243b3): per-vertex fixed-point inverse vs SimpleITK 1.1e-9 mm; ANTs antsApplyTransformsToPoints round-trips all 64,984 fsLR vertices within 1.0e-6 mm; real 3 beta + 12 FIR maps value/voxel/coverage-exact vs SimpleITK; Workbench sampling agreement (PLS Neuro aba3e40, max delta 4.66e-10).

Boundary constraint
atlas depends on surface; surface must not depend on atlas. The surface route must therefore admit a generic, evidence-carrying push-capable mapping (the reframe4s numerical-inverse estimate with its policy/lattice/residual evidence and an identity string), not MniTemplateBridge. Atlas (owner of the TemplateFlow asset admission) or a higher composition layer supplies it. Do not duplicate inversion machinery in surface.

Scope and acceptance
1. Typed bridge kind distinct from the refused exact pointwise inverse: route receipts and identity must name it as a numerical lattice inverse (lattice id, policy gates, settings, achieved residual evidence, Confidence.Approximate). Exact-inverse requests keep refusing.
2. Freeze, before evaluating at fsLR vertices, a vertex-level budget: per-vertex 6Asym->2009c placement error vs the existing SimpleITK/ANTs fixed-point oracle, and the count of vertices whose nearest source voxel or support/NoSupport status changes relative to the oracle placement (nearest-voxel sampling is discontinuous; sub-0.14 mm error can still flip voxels at boundaries). Every flip must be receipt-explained.
3. Real fixtures: locked TemplateFlow GM probseg (2009c res-01/res-02) and the dense full-support control under the user-adopted 2026-09-24 explained-missingness policy; medial wall vertex-exact; picks and display-geometry identity stable across inflated/veryinflated.
4. JVM + Scala.js (incl. FullOpt where the route runs), JDK17 and newer-JDK warning-clean, bounded timing/heap including the one-off inverse estimation cost (record it; consider a digest-bound cached estimate rather than per-session re-estimation).
5. Anatomical frame: this ticket qualifies the numerical bridge only. Whether the Conte69/fsLR midthickness frame may be admitted as MNI152NLin6Asym (declared-by-publisher tier with caveat vs documentary asset-bound evidence vs continued refusal) is a pending maintainer decision recorded on bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3; the route must surface whichever tier is chosen as typed provenance and must not imply registration proof.

Out of scope: PLS Neuro consumer migration/qualification (foreign-owned, bd-01M2421N7AZQX1AK5BEMVSB84K in plsneuro store; no cross-store blocking edge), publication/merge.
set.title: Declare and qualify the lattice numerical inverse as the fsLR route's 6Asym->2009c bridge
